rules.sentence: A clinician examining a hemangioma needs to look for indications of functional impairment, including airway compromise (eg, in subglottic hemangiomas) or sight blockage (eg, periocular lesions).
Systemic involvement indicators should be suspected in the presence of multiple cutaneous hemangiomas, which may indicate visceral lesions (eg, the liver).[19]
